messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to a full-body shot from the side. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video, then follow the described side full-body camera setup and movement. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to a full-body shot from the side. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still in profile, then bends forward at the waist, raises both hands to his face, and returns to an upright standing pose.","camera":"Static, eye-level, full-body side profile shot.","clothing":"White long-sleeved shirt under a dark brown vest, reddish-orange trousers, and dark slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Light brown to blond.","hairstyle":"Short, closely cropped hair on the sides and top of the head.","identity":"A slim, light-skinned 3D-rendered male character with a short buzzed haircut, shown in profile.","scene":"An outdoor industrial rooftop or yard with a large gray metal container behind the character, tiled and concrete ground, and buildings and scaffolding in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output changes from a front-facing full-body view to a static side-profile full-body shot. The character is placed in profile in front of a large gray container, matching the reference framing. The same character, outfit, hair, and action sequence are retained, with the forward bend and hand-to-face motion progressing through the clip.
arguments.requested_change: Switch the camera to a full-body side shot matching the reference's viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, appearance, outfit, action, environment, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the side view is the exact intended viewing direction from the reference or a mirrored side angle.
unexpected_changes: The environment appears to be a different part of the scene, with a large gray container and industrial yard background instead of the original storefront-facing plaza view.
